name: Blockstream Esplora public API (blockstream.info)
tier_rationale: Blockstream Corporation, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted). Registry tiers: Blockstream, Blockchain.com, BlockCypher and Blockchair trusted; mempool.space and litecoinspace community.

reliability.justification: Esplora reader of the public Bitcoin ledger: balances and transactions are verifiable chain facts (the unspendable genesis coinbase is not indexed by electrs, so balances can differ from other explorers).

esplora_api.title: Blockstream Esplora REST API (address stats, address txs with /txs/chain paging, chain tip)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

esplora_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 6). Research C0474 (verified_live 200): /api/address/{a}, /api/address/{a}/txs (25 confirmed per page), /api/address/{a}/txs/chain/{last_txid}, /api/blocks/tip/height; 'Public API of Blockstream (Esplora, MIT-licensed server software; self-hostable)'. Undocumented limits, 429 on bursts: <= 2 req/s, cache 1 h. Used by btc_explorers (one Esplora parser for Blockstream, mempool.space and litecoinspace).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P211). No published quota (429 = RATE_LIMITED and the host is short-circuited for the run by btc_explorers): politeness 0.5 s per request, crypto ttl 1 h, 5 s request timeout so the sequential failover stays within the 15 s explorer budget.
